# Security Policy

## Supported versions

| Version | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| 2.3.x | Yes |
| < 2.3 | No |

## Reporting a vulnerability

**Do not open a public issue for security vulnerabilities.**

Please use [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/NAIZO-NightBeam/Bosses/security/advisories/new) to report vulnerabilities privately. The maintainers will respond as quickly as possible.

If private advisory reporting is unavailable for this repository, open a draft issue marked **[SECURITY]** and avoid disclosing exploit details publicly.
